claim: The lifecycle tag is load-bearing for the graph-as-backlog: recurring directives are standing rules that never materialize, discrete directives are completable work, and the backlog query is unlinked plus lifecycle:discrete (b380's still-actionable test, narrowed to the work-bearing lifecycle class). An untagged directive degrades the backlog view.

evidence.detail: Extracted from the obligation-lives-in-the-graph position. Without the discrete/recurring discipline, bs list unlinked conflates standing rules with actionable work and the native backlog view reads wrong. Preflight 2026-06-11: tag-overlap with b380/b383 (tied in as deps) and b390 (deprecation convention, compatible); no semantic conflict.
